datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across South Sudan administrative units in 2011. The classifications were spatially encoded in GeoJSON and KML formats representing food insecurity phases at four time points (January, April, July, October), with scenario projections and assistance requirements documented for each geographic unit.
